overview.description: The T-REX 2X Long APH Daily Target ETF (APHU) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund seeks to deliver 200% leveraged exposure to the daily share price movements of Amphenol Corporation (APH), net of fees and expenses, through derivatives like swap agreements. APHU was launched on Feb 18, 2026 and is issued by Tuttle Capital Management.
